Season board rules

Every board runs per 14-day season and pays the top 5 in real USDT to the rewards balance. Cheating, banned accounts and excluded symbols (forex, metals, indices, stablecoins) never count.

Bank balance (Demo Spot)
  • Everyone starts Demo Spot with $10,000. The board ranks the highest bank-card balance above the start.
  • Money must be cashed out to your card in Demo Spot to count — coins still sitting on the exchange don't.
Example: you grow $10,000 to $13,400 and move it to your card — your board score is $13,400.
Highest ROE
  • Your best single closed paper trade of the season, measured by ROE (profit as % of your margin).
  • Only trades opened AND closed this season count, filled and closed by the server (no edited journals).
  • The ROE must be physically possible for the price move and leverage used — fabricated numbers are dropped.
Example: you open a BTC long at 20x and price rises 4% before you close — that trade's ROE is +80% and becomes your board entry if it's your best.
Best win rate
  • You need at least 20 counted trades closed this season.
  • A win only counts at +5% ROE or better on a real price move (at least 0.2%). Smaller profits count as neither. Losses always count.
  • Copies count once: identical positions (same coin, same direction) opened together and closed together count as one trade — 20 copies of the same position is 1 win, not 20.
  • Ranking uses a confidence-adjusted score, not the raw percentage: more games at a high win rate beat fewer games at a perfect one.
Example: 45 wins - 3 losses (93.8%) scores 89.1 and ranks ABOVE 20 wins - 0 losses (100%), which scores 83.9. A perfect record on few trades can't lock the board — consistency wins.
Example (copies): opening 10 identical SOL shorts in one minute and closing them together = 1 counted trade, win or lose.
Season XP
  • All XP you earn during the season counts: trading, Academy lessons, daily missions, duels, streaks.
  • Can't be gamed by position size — XP rewards activity, not margin.
Example: 30 closed trades, 12 Academy lessons and daily missions through the season can out-score one lucky trade.
